# otel-node

> Set up or debug OpenTelemetry in a Node.js service, including compatible SDK/API versions, ESM load order, bundled auto-instrumentation, async context propagation and exporter verification. Use when adding instrumentation or investigating missing spans. See opentelemetry for signal and span design.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/otel-node
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/otel-node
```

then run `apm install`.
